messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] Anybody want to Teach next Friday?
messages.subject_clean: [Epls-r-users] Anybody want to Teach next Friday?
messages.body_plain:
As most of you old-timers didn't make last Friday's class, we had about 10 new faces looking to learn R.  I did an impromptu introduction on Friday, but I'm looking to see if any of you who have been working on introductory R classes want to put together a more formal lesson plan.

Some possible topics:

1) Getting data into and out of R.

2) Basic R summary Statistics.

3) The lm command.

4) Data cleaning tricks and tips.

5) R graphics using graphics package.

6) R graphics using lattice package

7) R graphics using ggplot.

Contact me if you are interested.

    --Russell
